output.reason: PP 49/2023 recomposes the employer-paid JKK and JKM contribution rates to fund the JKP program. JKK falls by 0.14 percentage points per risk class (e.g. very low risk becomes 0.10%) and JKM falls from 0.30% to 0.20% of monthly wages. Employer-paid JKK and JKM premiums are part of a permanent employee's gross income for PPh 21, so the amount added to gross income changes for employees registered in JKP. The old rates remain for employees not registered in JKP or whose contributions are in arrears.
